Why the slowest feature is loved

Teams that ship a deliberate, slower feature often find it becomes the one people mention first. When a tool waits for the person instead of interrupting them, it earns a kind of trust that fast features rarely do.

We spoke with three small studios about the decisions behind their calmest features, and what they gave up to keep them that way. Read the full story.
